defect.proposed_fix: Keep the good_law label only with a caveat, or remove 'No negative treatment' until the proposed negative edges are audited. Suggested wording: 'Lake marks Rogers good_law as of 2026-06-30; disclosed progeny audit contains only proposed/mentioned negative edges requiring audit.'

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity states good_law as of 2026-06-30 and varies_by_point is false, so the main treatment label has disclosed support.
However, treatment.edges includes 31 proposed negative-status edges: overruled, questioned, criticized, and superseded_by_statute, all with field_iii 'mentioned'.
Derivation lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited both have audit_needed true, so an unqualified no-negative-treatment assertion is not safely verifiable from the disclosed record.
residual_risks: Because the negative edges are marked proposed and mentioned, the disclosed record does not prove Rogers is bad law; it proves the no-negative-treatment wording is overconfident.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Replace 'No negative treatment' with an audited-status caveat tied to the proposed/mentioned edge records.
